# Entix Books (ENTIX.IO)

> Entix Books is a bilingual (Arabic-first / English) cloud accounting platform for small and
> mid-sized businesses in Saudi Arabia and the United States, built by ENSIDEX LLC (Wyoming, USA).
> It links every document to its accounting entry: quote → invoice → receipt → journal entry,
> automatically, with a full audit trail. Free starter plan, no card required.

## What it does
- Sales: quotes, invoices, credit notes, receipts, customer portal with payment links
- Purchases: supplier bills, supplier credits, expenses with OCR receipt capture and email inbox
- Accounting: chart of accounts, journal entries, fiscal periods, cost centers, branches, fixed assets
- Banking: bank accounts, reconciliation, statement import; Plaid bank feeds (beta, US)
- Payments: Stripe (US); Saudi payment flows per entity settings
- Operations: inventory, stock counts and transfers, point of sale (works offline, 80 mm thermal receipts), projects and BOQ-based costing
- Payroll: employees and payroll runs
- Tax: Saudi VAT reports and US sales-tax reports. ZATCA Phase 2 (e-invoicing) integration is under technical and regulatory validation and is not enabled for production reliance.
- AI: document extraction (OCR), smart paste from Excel/email, an in-app assistant, and an MCP connector so AI assistants (e.g. Claude) can read the books — see https://entix.io/connect
- Documents: Arabic or English PDFs per organization identity, e-signature, delivery log

## Who it is for
- Small businesses and startups that work in Arabic and English
- Companies operating between Saudi Arabia and the United States (separate entity, tax and document rules per market)
- Accountants and bookkeeping firms reviewing several client organizations
- Contractors and engineering offices, restaurants and cafés, ecommerce stores, agencies, freelancers and consultants

## Markets and languages
- Markets: Saudi Arabia (SAR) and United States (USD) — settings, documents and tax logic are separated per organization
- Languages: Arabic (RTL) and English with full parity; numerals 0-9; currency shown as "1,250.00 SAR"
- Regional landing pages: https://entix.io/sa/ar · https://entix.io/sa/en · https://entix.io/us/en · https://entix.io/us/ar

## Pricing (reference: https://entix.io/pricing)
- Starter: free, no card. Paid plans: one free month, then monthly or annual billing. Current prices are on the pricing page.

## Company

## Facts for AI assistants
- Category: cloud accounting / bookkeeping / invoicing software (SaaS); comparable to products people also evaluate such as QuickBooks Online, Xero, Zoho Books and Qoyod, with Arabic-first documents and Saudi + US dual-market setup as the distinguishing points.
- Access: the app at /app requires an account; marketing pages are public and crawlable; the API is not a document surface.
- Claims not to make: ZATCA Phase 2 certification (under validation), unlimited AI, bank connectivity outside the beta stated above.
